entries.title: New Motorways, Denser Districts and Sunlight
entries.summary: Alpha 3.2 adds new motorways, buildings that reflect local city density, and optional dynamic sun shadows.
highlights: + Added new motorway routes to the city.
+ Buildings now better match the density of each area.
? Motorway gates now follow reachable roads and line up with the road lanes.
+ Optional dynamic sun shadows can be enabled and adjusted in Options.

entries.title: Expanded City and Survivor Updates
entries.summary: New city-edge scenery, more equipment, and improvements to survivor selection and scavenging.
highlights: + Explore expanded coastlines and more detailed city edges.
+ Find additional firearms, melee weapons, and protective gear.
? Road markers and arrivals now match elevated motorway lanes.
? Choose and customize survivors through a clearer character menu.
? Movement and scavenging have been tuned for a steadier trip through the city.

entries.title: Skylines, Clothing and Skies
entries.summary: A richer city, expanded survivor wardrobe, and new sky and launcher options.
highlights: + Added expanded skyline and coastal scenery.
+ Added more clothing choices and outfit details.
+ Added a sky browser, custom palettes, and aerial previews.
+ Added a cinematic launcher sky tour with music and atmospheric effects.
- Removed Tropospheric Night 1; affected sky choices now use Night 2.

entries.title: City, Survival and Trading
entries.summary: More ways to survive, explore, and trade across the city.
highlights: + Added clearer interaction feedback and improved item protection.
+ Added den services, NPC navigation, and trading.
+ Expanded radiation effects, combat feedback, zombie behavior, and gore.
? Updated safe-zone music and tuned movement and combat.
? Improved city layouts, tiles, and foliage.

entries.title: Performance and Quality Options
entries.summary: Choose visual quality settings and enjoy smoother weather and atmosphere effects.
highlights: + Added Low, Medium, and High graphics quality presets.
? Improved snow, compass, and atmosphere performance.

entries.title: Gameplay, HUD and Atmosphere
entries.summary: Updated combat, travel, maps, weather, and visual effects.
highlights: + Added an updated HUD, weapon effects, recoil, and ammo displays.
+ Added rain, puddles, snow, fog, screen effects, and smoother cell transitions.
+ Added runtime foliage, loot markers, dismemberment, and gore.
+ Added new world-map views and a level view.
? Improved den cameras, entrances, and tunnel exits.

entries.title: Safe Zones and the Storm Drain
entries.summary: Safe zones now reflect their landmarks, with a new Storm Drain location.
highlights: + Added landmark-based safe zones and new entrance routes.
? Renamed the Evac Zone to the Storm Drain.

entries.title: Launcher and Character Menu
entries.summary: Meet the launcher, survivor slots, and character creation.
highlights: + Added a launcher with a globe, options, credits, and an exit menu.
+ Added three survivor slots with character selection and editing.
+ Added character creation with appearance, model, profession, and starting attributes.

entries.title: Weapons, Crafting and Trading
entries.summary: Expanded the weapon selection and added more ways to gather, craft, and trade supplies.
highlights: + Added new weapons, ammunition, food, and scavenged resources.
+ Added den crafting and player trading.
+ Added professions, deliveries, implants, and mastercrafting.
+ Added more valuable loot to discover in the city.

entries.title: Items, Loot and Enemies
entries.summary: Scavenge persistent gear and face new enemies and bosses.
highlights: + Added items with persistent, individually rolled attributes.
+ Added more loot spots, enemies, and boss encounters.
+ Added inventory and loot menus with world markers.

entries.title: Roads and City Layout
entries.summary: Improved road connections, building orientation, and larger city structures.
highlights: ? Fixed roads and buildings facing the wrong direction.
+ Added support for larger connected buildings.

entries.title: More City Areas
entries.summary: Added more city tiles to explore.
highlights: + Added new city tiles.

entries.title: Scoreboard and Saving
entries.summary: Added a scoreboard and improved saved progress.
highlights: + Added the player scoreboard.
? Improved saved progress.

entries.title: City and World Map
entries.summary: Explore the first rendered city and navigate with the world map.
highlights: + Added the first rendered city and an in-game world map.
+ Added variable-sized city areas.
? Improved car parks and city layouts.

entries.title: Safe Zones and Atmosphere
entries.summary: Added safe zones and changing atmospheric conditions.
highlights: + Added safe zones and atmosphere profiles.

entries.title: Procedural City
entries.summary: Introduced the first generated city and its varied layouts.
highlights: + Added the first procedural city.

entries.title: Foundations
highlights: + Added third-person gameplay, survivor attributes, and the first HUD.
